name: Valinna

dialogue.speaker: Keshargo
dialogue.line: The hall, bask in its magnificence— shh! That's Valinna!
dialogue.trigger: Valinna is first encountered once you enter the Halls proper, Keshargo will ask you to take a look around before he notices Valinna and Riftmaster Naqri in conversation

dialogue.line: <He heads over to listen.>
dialogue.trigger: Valinna is first encountered once you enter the Halls proper, Keshargo will ask you to take a look around before he notices Valinna and Riftmaster Naqri in conversation

dialogue.speaker: Valinna
dialogue.line: I need that staff. Lock the gates, Riftmaster. No one leaves until I find it.
dialogue.trigger: Valinna is first encountered once you enter the Halls proper, Keshargo will ask you to take a look around before he notices Valinna and Riftmaster Naqri in conversation

dialogue.speaker: Riftmaster Naqri
dialogue.line: No one has ever challenged me and lived, Magnastylus.
dialogue.trigger: Valinna is first encountered once you enter the Halls proper, Keshargo will ask you to take a look around before he notices Valinna and Riftmaster Naqri in conversation

dialogue.speaker: Keshargo
dialogue.line: She has them calling her Magnastylus? No matter, the staff remains hidden. Our efforts may yet be successful.
dialogue.trigger: Valinna is first encountered once you enter the Halls proper, Keshargo will ask you to take a look around before he notices Valinna and Riftmaster Naqri in conversation

dialogue.line: <Valinna and Naqri move on.>
dialogue.trigger: Valinna is first encountered once you enter the Halls proper, Keshargo will ask you to take a look around before he notices Valinna and Riftmaster Naqri in conversation

dialogue.speaker: Valinna
dialogue.line: I must consult the web of truth. Alert me with any news of the staff or the old fool.
dialogue.trigger: Following Keshargo, you soon arrive in a vast library where Valinna will be giving orders to the Riftmaster

dialogue.speaker: Riftmaster Naqri
dialogue.line: No need to involve you, Magnastylus. I'll beat anyone who tries to get through here.
dialogue.trigger: Following Keshargo, you soon arrive in a vast library where Valinna will be giving orders to the Riftmaster

dialogue.line: <Valinna goes through door and Riftmaster Naqri stalks to the middle of the room.>
dialogue.trigger: Following Keshargo, you soon arrive in a vast library where Valinna will be giving orders to the Riftmaster

dialogue.speaker: Keshargo
dialogue.line: Naqri guards the rifts due to his more … aggressive nature. There'll be no reasoning with him.
dialogue.trigger: Following Keshargo, you soon arrive in a vast library where Valinna will be giving orders to the Riftmaster

dialogue.speaker: Keshargo
dialogue.line: Keshargo swears the Itinerant Staff lies in the Spiral Skein!
dialogue.trigger: Once you have defeated the Riftmaster, you continue to travel to the Deadlands Rift with Keshargo to retrieve the Itinerant Staff which he hid there. However, he is later ambushed by Sama-Rei and Mazandi accompanies you in Keshargo's place. After you retrieve the staff from the Deadlands you return to the Hall to meet with Keshargo but you learn something has gone wrong as he is not waiting for you. You follow Mazandi and Zilipif through the passages leading to the Spiral Skein rift, and soon find that Keshargo has been captured by Valinna for the location of the staff

dialogue.speaker: Valinna
dialogue.line: She didn't tell me? Nevertheless, you really are a fool.
dialogue.trigger: Once you have defeated the Riftmaster, you continue to travel to the Deadlands Rift with Keshargo to retrieve the Itinerant Staff which he hid there. dialogue.line: <Valinna sends Keshargo through a portal>

dialogue.speaker: Valinna
dialogue.line: I serve Mephala. Once the staff is mine, so will everyone else.
dialogue.trigger: Once you have defeated the Riftmaster, you continue to travel to the Deadlands Rift with Keshargo to retrieve the Itinerant Staff which he hid there. dialogue.speaker: Mazandi
dialogue.line: There they are, but Valinna blocked our path. We'll have to go the long way.
dialogue.trigger: To rescue Keshargo, you and Mazandi will have to catch up. As you approach you will hear Keshargo and Valinna talk some more

dialogue.speaker: Keshargo
dialogue.line: You turned your back on Hermorah.
dialogue.trigger: To rescue Keshargo, you and Mazandi will have to catch up. As you approach you will hear Keshargo and Valinna talk some more

dialogue.speaker: Valinna
dialogue.line: He is weak. Words and drawings change nothing!
dialogue.trigger: To rescue Keshargo, you and Mazandi will have to catch up. As you approach you will hear Keshargo and Valinna talk some more

dialogue.speaker: Keshargo
dialogue.line: You believe lies and deception do? Mafala is using your guilt against you.
dialogue.trigger: To rescue Keshargo, you and Mazandi will have to catch up. As you approach you will hear Keshargo and Valinna talk some more

dialogue.speaker: Valinna
dialogue.line: With the staff and her guidance, we won't have to watch idly while terrible things happen.

dialogue.line: You … lied? I will enjoy feeding you to the spiders.

dialogue.speaker: Valinna

dialogue.line: Ah, the staff. I don't need you anymore, Magnastylus. The Spinner provides.

dialogue.speaker: Mazandi
dialogue.line: Keshargo!

dialogue.line: We will string you up and watch you burn slowly.

dialogue.line: Hand over the Itinerant Staff and I'll have Lamikhai kill you quickly.

dialogue.line: This won't take long.

notes: Scribes of Mephala was written by Valinna.
related_quests: A War of Scribes: A usurper has taken control of the Scribes of Mora.
Pledge: Scrivener's Hall: Explore Scrivener's Hall and return Undaunted.
summary: Valinna is a Wood Elf and member of the Scribes of Mora who can be found in the Scrivener's Hall. She was the protégée of the Magnastylus Keshargo but after an incident in Apocrypha, she began to question the Scribes' role in the world. Valinna eventually found a new patron and initiated a coup to overthrow Keshargo and become the new Magnastylus of their order, seeking to redub it the "Scribes of Mephala". Alongside Lamikhai, Valinna is the final boss of the Scrivener's Hall dungeon.
